decks.notes: This aggressive Rakdos deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress while quickly deploying threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Voldaren Thrillseeker. The deck also utilizes powerful cards like Tree of Perdition and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to control the board and deal damage efficiently. By leveraging these synergies and utilizing Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion, this deck aims to pressure the opponent and close out games quickly before they have a chance to stabilize.

The key concept of the deck is to establish a strong board presence early on with efficient creatures like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Elite Spellbinder. The deck aims to apply pressure with aggressive creatures like Anointed Peacekeeper and Skyclave Apparition, while also having the possibility of surprise plays with Collected Company. The mana base includes a mix of dual lands to ensure consistency in casting spells. Ultimately, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly with a mix of creatures and disruption.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly flood the board with aggressive creatures and constantly pressure the opponent through direct damage and sacrificing mechanics. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells and disruptive interactions while utilizing the Cauldron Familiar and Witch's Oven combo for recurring value. Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional mana fixing and a powerful companion option. Mayhem Devil acts as a key piece in dealing incremental damage and disrupting the opponent's plans, while Ygara, Eater of All provides a strong finisher to close out games.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays and dealing damage quickly to the opponent. By utilizing cards like Ancestral Anger, Emberheart Challenger, and Screaming Nemesis, the deck aims to apply pressure early on and maintain a strong board presence. With cards like Leyline of Resonance and Might of the Meek to support the aggression, along with burn spells like Play with Fire and Spikefield Hazard, this deck aims to close out games before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. The key is to be fast and relentless in attacking the opponent.

This Rakdos Aggro deck aims to overwhelm opponents with fast and aggressive creatures and spells. The key strategy is to quickly build a board presence with efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger, while utilizing direct damage spells like Reckless Rage and Fatal Push to control the battlefield. Monstrous Rage and Heartfire Hero provide additional burst damage to finish off opponents quickly. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds consistency to the deck and allows for additional mana ramping. The deck's aggressive nature can quickly overwhelm opponents before they have a chance to stabilize.

This deck aims to establish an aggressive tempo by quickly deploying Spirit creatures and disrupting the opponent's game plan with countermagic and removal spells. The key strategy is to apply early pressure while maintaining control of the board through disruptive tactics. The deck's composition allows for flexibility in responding to various threats and adapting to different game states. By combining aggressive creatures with disruption, the deck aims to outpace the opponent and secure a victory through a combination of damage and control.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board and hand through counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. It looks to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win condition through card draw and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The inclusion of Kaheera as a companion adds an additional threat and provides synergies with the deck's creature base. The deck is designed to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent, maintaining control of the game until it can secure a victory.

This UW Control deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It also utilizes cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Narset, Parter of Veils to generate additional value and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional cards and versatility in the deck. The deck aims to stall the game, answer threats efficiently, and eventually overpower the opponent with powerful planeswalkers and card advantage spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Transmogrify combo to cheat powerful creatures into play, such as Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Hidetsugu Consumes All. It also includes disruption and removal spells to control the game and protect the combo. The main win condition is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures while using cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Case of the Stashed Skeleton to manipulate the board in your favor. Additionally, the inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds consistency and versatility to the deck.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quick and aggressive creature plays, utilizing powerful combat tricks and burn spells to deal damage quickly and efficiently to the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Monstrous Rage and Ancestral Anger to pump up creatures and push for even more damage. By utilizing the strength of cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Kumano Faces Kakkazan, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced and aggressive playstyle, aiming to win the game before the opponent can establish their own strategy.

The deck focuses on assembling the Greasefang Parhelion combo, utilizing cards like Altanak, the Thrice-Called, Overlord of the Balemurk, and Parhelion II to create a powerful engine that generates tokens and buffs them. The deck also includes control and card draw elements with cards like Thoughtseize, Bitter Triumph, and Raffine's Informant. The mana base is designed to support the combo pieces and ensure consistency in executing the combo. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a strong board presence and synergistic interactions.

The core strategy of this UW Control deck is to control the game through counter spells, removal, and card advantage, while also utilizing the companion Kaheera, the Orphanguard for additional value. The deck aims to stall the opponent's game plan, disrupt their strategies, and ultimately outvalue them in the late game. By utilizing cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, Settle the Wreckage, and March of Otherworldly Light, the deck seeks to establish dominance and control the pace of the game until it can secure a victory.

The deck focuses on fast, aggressive gameplay with a combination of low-cost creatures like Callous Sell-Sword and Emberheart Challenger, backed up by direct damage spells and pump effects like Titan's Strength. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion provides additional versatility and mana fixing. The key strategy is to quickly build a board presence and deal consistent damage to the opponent before they are able to stabilize. Additionally, the deck includes some utility lands like Den of the Bugbear and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance to provide additional options in different situations.

The main concept of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by using a combination of discard spells like Duress and Thoughtseize, removal spells such as Fatal Push and Sheoldred's Edict, and powerful creatures like Archfiend of the Dross and Unstoppable Slasher. The deck aims to control the game through attrition and eventually overpower the opponent with its threats. Liliana of the Veil provides additional disruption and card advantage, while the lands in the deck help to fix mana and provide utility.

The main concept of this UW Control deck is to control the board state using counterspells, removal spells, and board wipes while generating card advantage with card draw spells. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by efficiently dealing with threats and staying ahead in resources. The inclusion of Kaheera as a companion provides additional value and synergy with the deck's strategy. This deck excels at disrupting the opponent's game plan and ultimately taking control of the game through careful decision-making and resource management.

This deck focuses on utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to continuously tutor for creatures from the deck, while also controlling the board with cards like Chained to the Rocks and Leyline Binding. The deck includes a variety of powerful creatures with different abilities to adapt to different situations, as well as a mix of lands to ensure smooth mana base. The inclusion of the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad allows for additional value by blinking permanents for extra effects. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents through a combination of control and creature synergy.
